I recently completed an amazing trip with lalita tour & Travel covering Guwahati, Kaziranga, Shillong, and Cherrapunji, and it was an experience of a lifetime!
Guwahati: Started with the divine blessings at Kamakhya Temple. The city is the perfect gateway to the Northeast with great food and vibes.
Kaziranga National Park: A must-visit for wildlife lovers! Seeing the One-horned Rhino during the Jeep Safari was breathtaking. The management and the natural beauty of the park are top-notch.
Shillong & Cherrapunji: Meghalaya is truly the 'Abode of Clouds'. Shillong has a lovely cafe culture, and the drive to Cherrapunji is scenic. The Double Decker Living Root Bridge and Nohkalikai Falls are absolute wonders. Don't miss the crystal clear water at Dawki River nearby.
Overall, it's a perfect circuit for nature, adventure, and spirituality. The roads are well-maintained, and the local hospitality is heart-warming. Highly recommend this itinerary.

After contacting several travel agencies in Guwahati, I came across Lalita Tours and Travels through a travel group. After speaking with Ume-jee, I found the offer convincing and booked an 11-seater Tempo Traveller at a reasonable rate.
He ultimately provided us with a 17-seater vehicle that had ample space to store our luggage in the back. The driver was friendly, and our overall journey was smooth.
However, I would like to mention one point: although our Force Tempo Traveller was only a year and a half old, there was significant jerking from the third row onwards. Because of the long distances required to cover important tourist spots in Arunachal Pradesh, I suggest booking a Force Urbania instead for a more comfortable experience.
